mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways; methocarbamol acts as a central muscle relaxant while ivermectin can potentiate GABA-mediated chloride channels, resulting in additive CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression symptoms (dizziness, drowsiness, ataxia); counsel patient to avoid alcohol and use caution with hazardous activities; consider dose adjustment if significant CNS symptoms develop.
